title: Publish an idiomatic Go client for the OABP mission API
description: Build a public GitHub repository containing a Go client for the OABP mission API (list/get/create/submit). The repository must be non-empty and its primary language must be Go. Submit the repository URL as proof.

verification_params.oracle_description: Verify the submitted GitHub repository exists, is non-empty, and its primary language is Go (golang deliverable).
